sentences.en: Algeria has achieved the Millennium Development Goal in many sectors.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚在许多领域实现了千年发展目标。

sentences.en: A millennium is made up of a hundred decades.
sentences.zh: 一千年由一百个十年组成。

sentences.en: How many centuries are there in a millennium?

senses.zh: 千年期，千禧年；一千年，千年纪念；太平盛世，黄金时代
